introduction: Explore Yerdonia's cavern maze, learn the Yerdons' story and choose among ten independent native requests. Exact offerings and accepted receipts determine progress. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: ASK drustl about raxthan, quest, head or enslaver for the tribe's history, and drusto, jasmona, son or daughter for his family request. ASK dravkult about raxthan, graskal or noctule for the wider conflict. These are independent turn-ins; conversation and each keyword are not separate achievements.

Drustl accepts either Raxthan's head for serpentine leggings or his lost slime-covered arrow head for an earring. He leaves after either accepted request. Completing one does not unlock the other; a fresh available Drustl is needed for the second. The arrow head is carried by the slime-speckled slug accompanying the giant slug, not by Drustl or every slug.

Dravkult asks for Graskal's head and Noctule's black heart together. Some of his replies say two heads, but the accepted offering needs the heart. Raxthan carries his own head, and Noctule follows him and carries the heart. These are separate objects and requests, without a mandatory Drustl-before-Dravkult order.

T'rin also accepts Noctule's heart, paired with a Malstrog Bloodbeast heart. One copy of Noctule's heart can prepare either her request or Dravkult's, but it cannot be consumed for both. The Bloodbeast heart also has a separate use with Ravi Bjornson in Alatorin. Choose where to spend each copy; foreign acceptance does not finish a local request.

ASK rethorn about morklar or scales for his revenge and crafting request. Morklar carries large serpent scales and a different black heart. Only the exact scales fit Rethorn's offering. Epolon asks for Elytron's head and a giant zvorgast fang; ordinary zvorgasts and the other named hearts do not substitute.

ASK drasklor about darthus for his request. Darthus wields the spine that Drasklor accepts for a serpentine seal of Bozk. The seal is a reward, not an access key. Drasklor's hints about bones, searching, touching and gazing provide guidance; they do not declare an additional accepted puzzle or a requirement to wear the badge.

In the rock-filled room, TOUCH baphomet operates the wall symbol and clears the blocked northern passage toward the marble chamber. The return rock is an ordinary initially closed, unlocked door; OPEN follows native rules. The other symbol targets that return side and has nothing to clear while it is unblocked. A passage already opened by someone else remains usable without your own switch history.

The slab between the dismal cave and Raxthan's dark hall starts closed and unlocked on both sides. Its hidden-looking description does not itself make SEARCH mandatory. Follow the actual door and movement state. Dark caverns, bone-lined routes, the swamp, slug lair and bloody shaft retain their native travel, fall, breathing, combat and PvP restrictions.

Several downward routes have native fall chances. Flying, levitation, climbing, door state and actual arrival affect the journey. Falling into a room, seeing a route or reaching a named creature does not by itself prove a personal kill, source recovery, switch activation or accepted quest.

Trosat needs one strange mushroom from the orcish slave merchant's gnomeskin backpack. These differ from common cave shrooms and the dealer's other fungi. Grobklarn needs three exact cave shrooms for his ritual, offered together. Loose supplied mushrooms also fit; one or two cave shrooms do not prepare the three-shroom request.

Volgk accepts Agama's tongue for a mystical serpent-runed quiver. Agama currently carries that object. His dialogue mentions sparing her, but no recorded cutting, rescue or spared-life outcome is declared by this request. The card tracks the exact accepted item without inventing a method or making personal violence a prerequisite.

Carry each chosen offering loose to see current preparation. Held, worn, nested, consumed or handed-away items are not current preparation. Exact supplied items can fit without a personal kill, first-recovery or prior dialogue record. The item-and-item bundles settle as one native request; readiness and reward possession do not prove acceptance.

All ten native requests retire their recipient after acceptance. Source and recipient caps, reset timing and other players affect availability; potential daily eligibility does not guarantee fresh stock. Epolon's transformation, T'rin's hellfire, Grobklarn's ritual and freedom speeches are native completion narration, not additional recorded world-state achievements.

The local dealer also sells an azure potion, so owning that potion does not prove Grobklarn's ritual. Ordinary shopping, training, rune-covered stones, memories and descriptive symbols do not complete another local accepted request. Surface and Underdark passages, foreign quests and guarded arrival abilities retain their own ownership and discovery rules.

contacts.description: The witch doctor seeks strange mushrooms from the merchant, distinct from common cave shrooms.

contacts.description: The hunter offers independent Raxthan-head and lost-arrow-head requests. He leaves after either acceptance.

contacts.name: Volgk, The infamous slave trader
contacts.description: The trader accepts Agama's exact tongue. Dialogue does not declare a recorded spared-life outcome.

contacts.name: Dravkult, The Ancient One
contacts.description: The elder accepts Graskal's head together with Noctule's heart. The heart also serves T'rin's independent request.

contacts.name: Rethorn, The Raxian Craftsman
contacts.description: The craftsman seeks revenge on Morklar and accepts the serpent's exact scales for sleeves.

contacts.name: Epolon, Prince of Thrask
contacts.description: The prince accepts Elytron's head together with a giant zvorgast fang. Transformation text is completion narration.

contacts.name: T'rin, Priestess of Bozk
contacts.description: The priestess accepts Noctule's heart and a Bloodbeast heart. These compete with other independent uses.

contacts.name: Drasklor, Minion of Bozk
contacts.description: The minion accepts Darthus's spine for a seal and route hints. The reward is not a declared door key.

contacts.name: Grobklarn, Mystic of Mayhem
contacts.description: The mystic accepts three exact cave shrooms together for his ritual. Buying the same potion is not acceptance.
